content: We have carbon NMR shifts list. Need number of methyl groups (CH3). Methyl carbons typically appear around 10-30 ppm (for aliphatic). In list: 14.05, 18.60, 22.65, 27.60, 28.70, 31.31. That's six signals in that region. But some could be other carbons like methylene (CH2) also in similar region (20-40). Need to determine which are methyl. Could also use HSQC to see attached protons. Let's get HSQC.
